ops.body: Audit complete, fix shipped in v14.11.0 (commits 00cd3fc + 60a245f). Disposition of the 27 re-pins from 563d918: 5 behavioral regressions restored to pre-a3c57df expectations (loop-do-unwraps-body, while-condition-and-body, if-condition-then-else, function-definition-body-and-call, edge-function-def-and-call); cosmetic re-pins kept. walk() now has explicit arms for every compound NodeKind incl. header-word substitutions (for/select words, case subject+patterns, arith-for exprs, [[ ]]), compound redirects propagate to inner commands per old walker semantics, and eval payload enumeration restored + improved (static payload prefix visible, tainted-only suppressed, no double enumeration, quoted executables dequoted). Guard-evasion canary green: command_prefixes('if true; then rm -rf /; fi') includes rm. 3 codex review rounds to SHIP; cargo 401 + pytest 2488 green; goldens regenerated by script, byte-stable.
